Architectural review (software-architect): APPROVED. All acceptance criteria met: (1) JSON parsed and validated via deserializeJson() entry point, validateVersion() schema version check, validateDiagramRoot() root structure check, and per-field type validation throwing DiagramImportError; (2) diagram model reconstructed via deserializeDiagram(); (3) tables, columns, keys (primaryKey flag), constraints (uniqueConstraints), indexes (redistributed from diagram-level by tableId), and relationships all restored. Defense-in-depth stripCredentials() applied to export payload. Index round-trip fidelity verified by round-trip test. Observation (non-blocking): serializeDiagram() hardcodes uniqueConstraints: [] so unique constraints are lost on export; this is pre-existing and outside this ticket's deserialization scope - deserializer correctly restores uniqueConstraints from payload.
